# Scoped superclass arguments from static fields

A constructor forwards the original ConcurrentMap<Reference<K>,V> and a static
nominal field to its generic parent. Both enum constants and a mutable volatile
field retain their exact read, selected overload and snapshot. Four frozen
routes compare 96 cases twice with source/SDK parents, compile every output and
audit all original entries and metadata. Parent effects, partial field writes,
callbacks mutating the source field, null/raw inputs, late casts and exact
unchecked/hidden checked failures stay observable. Six wrong programs and six
Code-preserving Signature controls protect the binding. Only owned fixtures and
the trusted Java SDK execute.

The fixture explicitly checks the five disclosed enum projections and the one compiler-generated backing-array helper. It restores only the original synthetic access bit after compilation, verifies every Code attribute and all other classfiles are unchanged, then requires exact original class/method metadata and runtime behavior.
